record.oneLiner: A bipedal herbivore with an extremely thick, domed skull.
record.description: Pachycephalosaurus was a bipedal ornithischian herbivore from the very end of the Cretaceous in western North America, and the largest known pachycephalosaur at about 4.5 m long. It is famous for its extremely thick, domed skull roof — up to 22 cm thick — which may have been used for head-butting displays or combat.

notableFacts.text: Its skull roof was up to 22 cm thick — the thickest of any known dinosaur.
The dome may have been used for head-butting, like bighorn sheep.
The genera Stygimoloch and Dracorex may just be its growth stages.
